Flow.description: DWDECI-129. Blocks changing a Person Account's record type between Scholar and Contact (either direction), for all users including System Administrators - no exemption, per ticket decision. Compares RecordType.DeveloperName by name (not Id) so no hardcoded, environment-specific values - deploys unchanged to any org. The Record Type check is done in a Decision, not the Start filter, per the established pattern in this org (a RecordType.DeveloperName cross-object Start filter deploys and activates cleanly but throws an unhandled runtime exception on every trigger - see Opportunity_On_Create_Default_MOU_Requirement). Uses the native Custom Error element since Record-Run-Before-Save flows disallow Action elements entirely.
Flow.interviewLabel: Account - Before Save - Block Scholar Contact RT Change {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Account - Before Save - Block Scholar Contact RT Change
